messages:
ara: FYI - noticed onboarding flakiness for next-edge samples after we published @redwood/sdk 1.5.0. Cloudflare Pages and Vercel edge both reported import failures.

ara: sample-app error: `TypeError: Redwood is not a function` when doing `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` in an edge handler. Node server runtime builds fine.

ben: hmm, did the publish collapse export targets again? i remember we deduped files by pointing exports to ./lib/index.js which is actually CJS. Some bundlers will resolve that as ESM and try to default-import it.

zoe: also seeing TypeScript reports: consumers using `esModuleInterop: false` now get incompatible d.ts shapes. our generated declarations changed to `export =` style in the last build. two customers opened tickets this morning.

ara: repro steps i used:
1) yarn add @redwood/sdk@1.5.0
2) create worker: `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'`
3) deploy to CF Pages emulator -> fails at import

ben: quick fix: restore conditional export map in package.json: "{ \".\": { \"import\": \"./esm/index.mjs\", \"require\": \"./cjs/index.cjs\" }, \"./package.json\": \"./package.json\" }". ensures deterministic resolution for ESM environments and legacy require.

zoe: agree. also change types to point at ESM-compatible dts (esm/index.d.ts) and ensure the DTS generator emits `export default` shapes for default import consumers.

ara: can we publish a patch today? onboarding tests are failing in CI for new signups.

ben: will prepare 1.5.1 with corrected exports + dts fix. adding a small prepublish script that runs a smoke import against node --input-type=module and a quick esbuild bundle test to catch resolver mismatches.

release-bot: release-1.5.1 job queued (job id r-9921) :rocket:

zoe: i'll add an edge-import smoke to sample-apps CI that simply does `await import('@redwood/sdk')` in a matrix job to fail fast on future regressions.

ben: local canary built and smoke passed in CF emulator. publishing now. will post npm link.

release-bot: 1.5.1 published: https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/sdk/v/1.5.1

ara: retested sample-apps on edge matrix - all green. thanks! :tada:

zoe: follow-ups: add export-map checklist to release playbook, include DTS sanity check in CI, and add short DX doc recommending export patterns for edge and bundlers. i'll draft the doc.

ben: note for changelog: "Fix: conditional exports and typings to avoid ESM/CJS import breakages on edge runtimes"

ara: perfect. closing the loop. lesson: small export map tweaks can cause big onboarding friction.
